profile_text: With a focus on auditing and financial examination, this Düsseldorf-based firm has experienced significant growth, increasing its employee base by 56.2% since the baseline. As a specialist in Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, the company provides critical services to businesses, leveraging its expertise to drive expansion. Operating from its Bahnstraße 16 location, the firm's success is reflected in its growing team of 25 employees as of 2024.
